description: Every turnover series must carry a derivatives risk category (DER_RISK).
logic_definition: No row in finance_data where DER_RISK is NULL or blank. SQL: SELECT * FROM finance_data WHERE DER_RISK IS NULL OR TRIM(DER_RISK) = '';
remediation_action: Reject the feed and ask the source to repopulate DER_RISK.

description: The 2013 turnover column must be populated for every reported series.
logic_definition: No row in finance_data where 2013 is NULL or blank. SQL: SELECT * FROM finance_data WHERE 2013 IS NULL OR TRIM(2013) = '';
remediation_action: Confirm whether 2013 is in scope; backfill from the historical extract or mark the column out of scope.

description: The 2019 turnover column should be mostly populated; up to 30% of series may legitimately have no 2019 observation.
logic_definition: No row in finance_data where 2019 is NULL or blank. SQL: SELECT * FROM finance_data WHERE 2019 IS NULL OR TRIM(2019) = '';
remediation_action: If the gap exceeds 30%, investigate the 2019 extract before publishing.

description: DER_CPC must be one of the three published counterparty-country groupings.
logic_definition: DER_CPC belongs to the allowed set. SQL: SELECT * FROM finance_data WHERE DER_CPC NOT IN ('1E', '5J', '5Z');
remediation_action: Map the unknown code or extend the reference list.

control_name: Counterparty sector is an accepted code
description: DER_SECTOR_CPY must belong to the accepted counterparty-sector set (A-J, P, U, V, W). 'X' (related-party trades) is not accepted here.
logic_definition: DER_SECTOR_CPY belongs to the allowed set. SQL: SELECT * FROM finance_data WHERE DER_SECTOR_CPY NOT IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I', 'J', 'P', 'U', 'V', 'W');
remediation_action: Confirm whether related-party trades ('X') belong in this cut; if so, add 'X' to the rule, otherwise correct the source classification.

description: The Series identifier must be upper-case alphanumerics and colons only (the BIS key convention).
logic_definition: Series matches the pattern '^[A-Z0-9:]+$'. SQL: SELECT * FROM finance_data WHERE NOT regexp_matches(Series, '^[A-Z0-9:]+$');
remediation_action: Trim stray characters / whitespace from the Series key at the source.

description: The Series key must identify exactly one row in the extract.
logic_definition: No duplicate on (Series). SQL: SELECT Series, COUNT(*) FROM finance_data GROUP BY Series HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
remediation_action: De-duplicate the extract and investigate the source join.

control_name: One row per business dimension combination
description: The combination of every business dimension (country, instrument, risk, sector, both currency legs, maturity, rating, execution method, basis) is expected to identify a single series.
logic_definition: No duplicate on (DER_REP_CTY, DER_INSTR, DER_RISK, DER_SECTOR_CPY, DER_CURR_LEG1, DER_CURR_LEG2, DER_ISSUE_MAT, DER_RATING, DER_EX_METHOD, DER_BASIS). SQL: SELECT DER_REP_CTY, DER_INSTR, DER_RISK, DER_SECTOR_CPY, DER_CURR_LEG1, DER_CURR_LEG2, DER_ISSUE_MAT, DER_RATING, DER_EX_METHOD, DER_BASIS, COUNT(*) FROM finance_data GROUP BY DER_REP_CTY, DER_INSTR, DER_RISK, DER_SECTOR_CPY, DER_CURR_LEG1, DER_CURR_LEG2, DER_ISSUE_MAT, DER_RATING, DER_EX_METHOD, DER_BASIS HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
data_element: DER_REP_CTY, DER_INSTR, DER_RISK, DER_SECTOR_CPY, DER_CURR_LEG1, DER_CURR_LEG2, DER_ISSUE_MAT, DER_RATING, DER_EX_METHOD, DER_BASIS
remediation_action: Review the grain of the extract: add the missing dimension(s) to the key or aggregate the duplicates.

control_name: Counterparty sector exists in the code table
description: Every DER_SECTOR_CPY value must exist in the counterparty-sector reference code table.
logic_definition: Every DER_SECTOR_CPY in finance_data exists in ref_dimension_codes.sector_code. SQL: SELECT s.* FROM finance_data s LEFT JOIN ref_dimension_codes r ON s.DER_SECTOR_CPY = r.sector_code WHERE r.sector_code IS NULL;
remediation_action: Add the missing code to ref_dimension_codes or correct the source value.

control_name: Counterparty country exists in the code table
description: Every DER_CPC value must exist in the counterparty-country reference code table (which currently lists only 1E and 5J).
logic_definition: Every DER_CPC in finance_data exists in ref_dimension_codes.cpc_code. SQL: SELECT s.* FROM finance_data s LEFT JOIN ref_dimension_codes r ON s.DER_CPC = r.cpc_code WHERE r.cpc_code IS NULL;
remediation_action: Extend ref_dimension_codes with the missing counterparty-country grouping (5Z) after confirming it is a valid published code.

description: Every country feed in feed_status must have been refreshed within the last 3650 days (sanity bound).
logic_definition: last_updated is not older than 3650 day(s) relative to today. SQL: SELECT * FROM feed_status WHERE last_updated < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3650' DAY;
remediation_action: Investigate any feed with no refresh in a decade -- likely decommissioned.

description: Every country feed in feed_status must have been refreshed within the last 7 calendar days.
logic_definition: last_updated is not older than 7 day(s) relative to today. SQL: SELECT * FROM feed_status WHERE last_updated < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7' DAY;
remediation_action: Chase the source for the stale country feeds; escalate if no refresh in the next cycle.

control_name: EUC positions tie to the ledger
description: Each EUC position amount must match the ledger amount within 1%.
logic_definition: Value of amount reconciled between recon_euc_positions and recon_gl_match (tolerance 1%). SQL: SELECT * FROM recon_euc_positions s FULL OUTER JOIN recon_gl_match r ON s.deal_id = r.deal_id WHERE s.deal_id IS NULL OR r.deal_id IS NULL OR ABS(s.amount - r.amount) / NULLIF(r.amount, 0) * 100 > 1;
remediation_action: Escalate any residual break to Finance Control.

control_name: EUC positions tie to the ledger (stressed feed)
description: Each EUC position amount must match the stressed ledger extract within 1% (this extract has three re-priced deals and one dropped deal).
logic_definition: Value of amount reconciled between recon_euc_positions and recon_gl_break (tolerance 1%). SQL: SELECT * FROM recon_euc_positions s FULL OUTER JOIN recon_gl_break r ON s.deal_id = r.deal_id WHERE s.deal_id IS NULL OR r.deal_id IS NULL OR ABS(s.amount - r.amount) / NULLIF(r.amount, 0) * 100 > 1;
remediation_action: Investigate each break: confirm the trade economics, then correct the EUC or the ledger; chase the deal that is missing on the ledger side.
